sections.title: CRM Tools for Salesforce
sections.subtitle: PocketWiSE SFE, PM App, and SOLE - Paperless customer engagements and transactions for large sales forces

products.title: PocketWiSE SFE
products.description: An integrated mobile solution that provides real-time capturing and sending of customer coverage and engagements from the field directly to the head office. Now comes with new remote features!
products.longDescription: Looking to take your sales productivity to the next level? Look no further than SFE. This comprehensive Mobile CRM automates customer coverage, planning, presentations, and even transactions. Plus, with new health-protocol compliant features like contactless call confirmation and MD rating, SFE is perfect for businesses in the new normal. Give your sales force the tools they need to succeed with SFE.

benefits.title: Real-time Access to Field Data
benefits.description: SFE allows field sales reps to send data instantly, which can be immediately turned over for management. This increases the process of turning key information like customer transactions and visits in a timely manner, so this crucial info is always at your fingertips!

benefits.title: Accurate and Verifiable Reports
benefits.description: For businesses who are looking to maximize their productivity, SFE is an app that automatically captures data of sales. This means no more errors and delays with field reports as they can be instantly generated using this program! The best thing about it? It comes complete call confirmation where you record the signature from your customer for assurance on coverage or visit done by rep during work hours.

benefits.title: Sales Productivity and Efficiency
benefits.description: With the SFE, reps can focus on what they do best and leave all of this paperwork to us. We take care not only for their efficiency but also its profitability by including product presentations in our application so that no detail goes overlooked when it comes down making sure customers are happy!

benefits.title: Proactive Decision-Making
benefits.description: With the new system, managers can now receive field data immediately from their reps. They won't have to wait a day before releasing guidelines and decisions that could affect operations in-field since they are able to make these critical split moments of decision making on urgent matters themselves with ease thanks for this quick access!

benefits.title: Save on Cost and Time, and Increase in Revenue
benefits.description: SFE has helped companies of all sizes streamline their operations by eliminating the tedious paperwork that comes with it. From mailing and paper costs, users can save up to a week or even one month's worth which leads them more time for engaging customers ultimately boosting sales and increasing revenue as well!

benefits.title: Efficient Progress Management
benefits.description: Customizable workflows for processes like sales order approvals and invoice collections ensure streamlined operations and effective management of exceptions.

benefits.title: Accelerated Business Processes
benefits.description: The platform accelerates the Order-to-Cash cycle by streamlining sales, order management, invoicing, and payment processes, leading to improved cash flow and operational efficiency.

products.heroSubtitle: The game-changer application in the Pharma industry
products.useCase:
SFE is the flagship mobile solution of eScience which is used by 70+ pharmaceutical companies in the Philippines accounting to almost 20% of the pharma market share in the country.

SFE, as an integrated productivity tool, helped these pharma companies monitor all field activities in real-time. Medical or sales rep in the field can easily send their computed KPIs, monthly coverage plan (MCP), call or coverage reports, and inventory of their samples to their district managers. With the automated process, reports which used to take weeks or month to accomplished can be done and sent instantly. The management can now also proactively decide on strategies on how to increase product sales and marketing activities.

products.title: PocketWiSE for Managers (PM App)
products.description: Designed for district managers leading their sales force, PM app is the partner application of SFE to oversee the customer coverage and KPI's of every field personnel.
products.longDescription: PocketWiSE for Managers, known as PM app, is the perfect tool for district managers who want to coach their reps more effectively. This app allows you to join calls or coverage with your reps, and gives you access to their current KPIs and sales performance. With this information at your fingertips, you can coach your reps based on their individual needs.
products.heroSubtitle: The mobile solution for district managers

benefits.title: Fast and Easy Monitoring for Sales Rep's Performance
benefits.description: PM App paired with SFE, Managers can now review and approve coverage plans for their sales reps in real time, without waiting on paperwork. This means that they will never miss an important update about what is happening with a particular rep's performance ever again!

benefits.title: Real-time Coaching
benefits.description: District managers can easily check their targets and goals for the month, so they know how to effectively supervise sales representatives in order ensure that every territory or customer gets covered.

benefits.title: Better Collaboration and Coordination between Sales of Every Territory
benefits.description: The PM App has a feature that allows managers to join calls or visits with their sales reps in order check how they are performing. This will allow them to assess every rep's effectiveness, as well help if any customer issues arise while on-site A great way for company owners/managers alike!

benefits.title: Proactive Decision-Making
benefits.description: With PM App, the DMs are always prepared for any situation that may arise. They can proactively anticipate and solve incidents before they ever happen with ease thanks to real-time data captured by this app!

products.title: Sales, Opportunities, Leads, and Engagements (SOLE)
products.description: Manage your sales pipeline and customer relationships using SOLE. Be on top of every opportunity with the CRM on your mobile phone!
products.heroSubtitle: Be on top of every opportunity with a handheld CRM
products.longDescription: Sales, Opportunities, Leads, and Engagements or SOLE is the perfect handheld CRM to manage your customers and sales pipeline while on the go. With complete features that include contact management, lead capture and tracking, and sales analysis tools, SOLE ensures you're always in control of your business dealings. SOLE makes it easy to stay organized and focused on your goals, so you can close more deals quickly and easily.
products.useCase:
SOLE is a complete customer relationship lifecycle management solution that automates your company’s sales engagement process. It is a sales productivity platform that gives your field force personnel access to the information they need to be effective in their work. It allows them to easily & quickly manage leads, contract, deals, opportunities and interactions using their mobile device. SOLE also works offline and synchronizes data with a cloud-based server. 

 SOLE includes a wide range of graphical reports and analytical tools to give valuable insights on the opportunities, leads, deal progression, profitability and much more.

benefits.title: Efficient Customer-Relationship Management
benefits.description: SOLE is a revolutionary CRM system that provides sales reps with an all-inclusive tool to help them manage their customers and even prospects more efficiently. This sleek, user-friendly platform organizes leads for easy navigation through different stages of deals from managing existing clients right down the line - cutting down on time wasted sorting data into excel sheets!

benefits.title: Oversee Leads and Sales Pipeline by Sales Rep
benefits.description: With the help of our interactive webtool, you can easily keep an eye on your sales reps and their activities. You'll know who they're working with at all times so there will never be any disputes about which customer or company belongs to them!

benefits.title: Focus on Sales Productivity
benefits.description: Sales reps can now focus less on finishing their reports and more time finding new customers. SOLE also comes with an activity report for each sales representative which is automatically generated, sent to management - keeping them up-to date about what's happening.

benefits.title: Real-time Tracking of Opportunities and Leads to Boost Sales
benefits.description: SOLE's technology is designed to help your sales team close more deals and convert every prospect. With SOLE, you can easily monitor the progress of each opportunity so that all resources are focused on how best to keep this customer engaged for them to eventually become loyal customers!

posts.title: Only Filipino tech company invited for Amazon Web Services (AWS) Summit 2018 in Singapore
posts.excerpt: Enter a short summary of the article here...

blocks.content: eScience in AWS Summit held in Singapore

eScience was the only Filipino IT company invited to join the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Partner Summit to be one of the tech exhibitors. AWS Partner Summit was held in Singapore on April 5, 2018. 

eScience Corporation was proud to showcase its Filipino-made CRM application, SOLE. Sales Opportunities Leads, and Engagement (SOLE) is a CRM application that can be used on mobile phones and even offline which transmits field sales data from the user to the management in real-time.

PocketWiSE series are mobile apps that helps FMCG, retail and distribution, warehouse management, and pharmaceutical companies to automatically send real-time field data to the management portal or headquarters using a low-end mobile phone and 3G/4G/Wi-fi network. This solution helped 80+ companies in the Philippines make proactive decisions for their field stores and operations.

eScience CEO Ricky Dagelet, together with Project Manager Khaye Becina and Innovations Team Head Joseph Maiquez, represented eScience in the AWS Partner Summit. Becina served as the technical product head who developed SOLE.

Before SOLE’s official launch in May, the Singaporean attendees already had a glimpse of what SOLE can do to boost sales productivity and to manage the sales pipeline efficiently. 

Amazon Web Services, (AWS) a worldwide cloud computing service provider, has been eScience’s partner for almost a decade now.

posts.title: Sales Force Automation for Van Sales and PocketWiSE for Sales and Merchandisers joins Samsung Business Technology Summit
posts.excerpt: Enter a short summary of the article here...

blocks.content: SFA Van Sales at Samsung Business Technology Summit

Samsung Business announced its initial plans to deliver enterprise mobility solutions for a number of industries last July 21-22 in Marriott Hotel Cebu. Once implemented, the plans are expected to help create an enterprise mobility ecosystem based on Samsung mobile devices. The new ecosystem will be designed to build on the popularity and reach of Samsung's mobile innovations.

The new plans are to add to Samsung's broad portfolio of devices, wearables and enterprise mobility solutions so users can benefit from SAP Mobile Platform and have more secure and simple integration with SAP's ecosystem. It is intends to combine and allow the extension of enterprise applications in a secure intuitive manner to the extended workforce and help provide businesses with shorter time to market, quicker access to revenue streams and improved real-time decision support to executives and the workforce. 

As a market leader in market devices and solutions, Samsung knows how to bridge consumer expectations for what a premium mobile experience should feel like with a readiness for the enterprise environment. E-Science is proud to be one of Samsung Business Philippines' technology partner. PocketWiSE SFE for Van Sales and PocketWiSE for Merchandisers PSM were featured in the two-day summit where Samsung's industry partner vendors are gathered.

The collaboration between Samsung Business Philippines and E-Science is expected to create new opportunities for developers to build solutions that can leverage the integrated offering from Samsung and E-Science on mobile devices. The parties plan for mobile applications and user experiences to be engineered to help take advantage of Samsung device capabilities, thus aimed at giving a competitive advantage to workforces that use Samsung mobile devices. This approach is expected to help facilitate web and mobile developers to innovate with Samsung, and the large System Integrators ecosystems of both companies may be enabled to more quickly create vertical solutions that can address the needs of the market and the game-changing opportunities in the mobile solutions arena.

posts.title: A New Identity for a Dynamic Future: eScience Unveils SwiftPoint!
posts.excerpt: Enter a short summary of the article here...

blocks.content: eScience Unveils SwiftPoint

The highly anticipated event of eScience took a momentous launch last July 12, 2023 at Ascott Hotel Makati. Marking a significant milestone in the company's journey, this transformational event drew representatives from different industries, all eager to witness what’s new with eScience.

SwiftPoint, a cutting-edge application that empowers your field-deployed employees to effortlessly submit attendance, track activities, monitor inventories and handle work-related tasks directly from their smartphones. eScience showcased its new visual identity and tagline signaling a powerful shift in its focus and vision. The new logo, symbolizing modernity and progress, and its new tagline, “Swift Reports, On Point” indeed embodied SwiftPoint’s commitment to pushing boundaries and driving innovation in the technology space. Truly, you would say goodbye to tedious paperwork and hello to convenience, efficiency, and real-time updates with SwiftPoint!

Ms. Riva de Castro, Former Sales Operation Associate Director of a distinguished company in the Philippines and a respectable figure in the world of data analytics with over 20 years of experience in the area of Sales, Trade Marketing & Business Data Analysis, marked the event as the keynote speaker for the afternoon. With a wealth of knowledge and experience, she captivated the audience with her insights, guiding them through the transformative power of data and its untapped potential.
The Launch of AI-Powered IMAGE2TEXT: Unleashing Creative Potential at eScience

The recent rebranding marked a significant moment for SwiftPoint, setting the stage for an exhilarating future. However, the highlight of the unforgettable evening was undoubtedly the introduction of SwiftPoint's newest technology - the AI-powered IMAGE2TEXT. This leading-edge innovation represents a giant leap forward in the realms of artificial intelligence and image recognition. 

Attendees were given the chance to experience firsthand the capabilities of the Image2Text. In real-time, Image2Text demonstrated its ability to accurately recognize and extract meaningful inventory information from the images, converting them into textual data with an average accuracy of 95% - 98%.

SwiftPoint's AI-generated IMAGE2TEXT carries the potential to transform industries and streamline workflows. From expediting data entry processes to unlocking valuable insights hidden within images, the feature is boundless. The technology's versatility and precision promise to open new doors for businesses seeking a competitive edge.

Truly, the two-day event was a great success!  

We are all excited for what the rest of 2022 will bring to us. 

May offer back to God all the glory & honor!

posts.title: eScience goes to Boracay for annual company outing
posts.excerpt: Enter a short summary of the article here...

blocks.content: Boracay Outing 2015

Work, we believe, needs to be fun, educational and something that makes you so excited that you jump out of bed each morning. Over the last 15 years E-Science has won awards and accolades for creating innovative mobile solutions to business problems, so to celebrate its enduring legacy, we decided to fly the entire team on a retreat to one of the most beautiful beaches in Asia -Boracay.

It was December 2014 when E-Science announced our Boracay outing last March 12-15, 2015. Sixty people confirmed, we had a year to plan but had a limited budget. Did we panic? No! This activity was a product of fervent prayers and a lot of hard work. This event was one year in the making and had a lot of go and no-go challenges but we kept on going until we could find the right timing and support to make it possible. So here's a rundown of our itinerary in our 3-day Boracay outing on a peak season.

We left the office at 4pm on March 12, 2015, Thursday to go to Batangas Port. Everyone had fun playing message relay about common adages in travelling and barely felt the 3-hour ride to the port. We boarded a ship and before we knew it, we were at the Caticlan Jetty port at 6:00 in the morning the following day. 

From Caticlan, we boarded the boat in one batch and arrived at Boracay for a van transfer to our hotel at Boracay Uptown. We arrived at the hotel at round 9 in the morning.

Waterskiing, Banana Boat, Helmet Diving, Kite Flying, Kite Surfing, Snorkeling, Island hopping and Parasailing are all activities anyone can enjoy on the beach. Some groups decided to go parasailing to see the glorious panoramic view of Boracay?s vast shoreline. Other groups decided to go jet skiing. While others tried the paraw, a small outrigger sailboats for 2 to 6 people.

Our hotel was situated in Station 2, fronting the beach. The hotel was quite new. It had two swimming pools, and one was an infinity pool situated at the roof deck of the hotel fronting the beach. The rooms were spacious and clean, complete with all the things we needed to relax. The hotel staff were very accommodating. At around 3 in the afternoon we all had our official water activities ?the banana boat ride and helmet diving. We all enjoyed the water activities that day including those who fell off the banana boat. Helmet diving was memorable as a number of us experienced it for the first time. 

Everyone was hungry at the end of the day. We headed back to the hotel for dinner at Aqua fire. There were fire dancers with spectacular dance moves. The day ended early so some of us decided to go pub crawl, where we met amazing people from around the world, played get-to- know-you games, drank welcome shooters with our free shooter glass, got discounts on drinks, got free entrance in bars, and wore a yellow iconic pub crawl shirt. This was definitely one of the most awesome memories our group experienced in the island's famous nightlife. 

We had buffet breakfast on the fifth floor of the hotel the following day. Every kind of tasty food you can imagine for breakfast was served at the buffet table. After breakfast, we took a boat trip around the island for sightseeing and snorkeling. But the area where we snorkel and took quick dips was infested with jellyfish. We hurriedly boarded the boat after noticing how itchy the water felt on our skin.

We finally headed to Puka Beach to have a picnic by the beach for lunch. This was where we had fun playing beach volleyball, swimming, and shopping for souvenirs. 

We headed back to the hotel to quickly recharge and shower to prepare for the night's main event. The White Summer Dinner Party, where everyone wore all white to celebrate the night with a sumptuous dinner. During the dinner program, our CEO, Ricky Dagelet shared E-Science?s history and its accomplishments for the past 15 years. He thanked everyone and shared his vision for E-Science. He also shared exciting projects that E-Science has lined up and encouraged everyone to participate in making remarkable and innovative products. There was a short presentation from ESC Heads, the company's unofficial band. They played songs and everyone sang along. The hosts, Herbie Bagsik and Rose Ann Tan, facilitated a quick trivia game about E-Science. Although the weather was not good that night, we still pushed through with our sky lantern lighting competition. Lighting the lantern was our symbol of hope for a prosperous future of E-Science. Lester Ruiz and Juvy Palaca won the competition. 

The next day, we left the hotel at round 7AM and rode a bus to Kalibo Airport. We arrived in Manila happy, hopeful, and grateful.

posts.title: Wonders of Vietnam: Da Nang Getaway 2025
posts.excerpt: Xin chào, eScience! Our team recently embarked on an unforgettable journey to Central Vietnam, exploring the vibrant landscapes of Da Nang and the timeless charm of Hoi An.

blocks.content:
Xin chào, eScience!

Last February, 2025, we set off for an unforgettable escape to the heart of Central Vietnam—exploring the vibrant city of Da Nang and the enchanting lantern-lit streets of Hoi An. From majestic mountains to ancient towns, every moment was packed with awe, laughter, and memories we’ll cherish forever.
Day 1: Arrival in Da Nang – Touchdown and Take It Slow

Our journey began with excitement as we landed in the coastal city of Da Nang. Greeted by sunny skies and warm breezes, we checked into our accommodations and took the rest of the day to settle in, relax, and sample local Vietnamese cuisine. Some wandered along the beachfront, while others explored the lively city streets or just unwound at the hotel.

blocks.caption: Touching the clouds: The eScience team at the iconic Golden Bridge in Ba Na Hills.

blocks.content: Day 2: Sun World Ba Na Hills – Where Dreams Meet the Clouds
An early start led us up to the mountaintop marvel that is Sun World Ba Na Hills—an experience nothing short of magical.

We ascended via one of the world’s longest cable car rides, where the views were nothing but spectacular. First stop, The Golden Bridge, held gracefully by two giant stone hands—an architectural icon that took our breath away.
Day 3: Hoi An – A Step Back in Time

Our final day was dedicated to the UNESCO-listed Hoi An Ancient Town. We started with a thrilling (and dizzying!) Basket Boat Ride at Cam Thanh Coconut Village, where the team tested their balance and cheered on the local boat performers. Later, we strolled through Hoi An’s lantern-lit streets, admired the Japanese Covered Bridge, and explored the local markets for unique souvenirs.

blocks.caption: A splash of fun: Navigating the coconut groves of Cam Thanh in traditional basket boats.

blocks.content:
A Journey to Remember

As we returned home, we brought back more than just photos and souvenirs; we brought back closer bonds and a renewed energy to innovate. Vietnam was truly a wonder, and we can't wait for the next eScience adventure!

posts.content:
Xin chào, eScience! Our team recently embarked on an unforgettable journey to Central Vietnam, exploring the vibrant landscapes of Da Nang and the timeless charm of Hoi An. From mountain peaks to ancient streets, here's a look back at our February 2025 getaway.



Day 1: Arrival in Da Nang – Touchdown and Take It Slow


Touchdown in Central Vietnam! Our team arrived in breezy Da Nang, ready for a well-deserved break from the typical work week. We checked into our cozy accommodations and immediately dove into the first order of business: authentic Vietnamese cuisine. From savoring freshly chilled welcome drinks to enjoying a beachside dinner under the stars, the first day was all about relaxation and soaking in the coastal vibes.



Day 2: Sun World Ba Na Hills – Where Dreams Meet the Clouds


Day two took us high into the Truong Son Mountains to the enchanting Sun World Ba Na Hills. We walked along the world-famous Golden Bridge, held by two giant stone hands that seem to emerge from the mountainside. After exploring the Le Jardin d’Amour flower gardens and the whimsical French Village, the team headed to Fantasy Park for some high-energy fun. We wrapped up the day with a visit to the pastel-pink Da Nang Cathedral, a charming colonial landmark in the heart of the city.


Events like these remind us that our greatest strength isn't just the technology we build, but the incredible people we build it with.

Day 3: Hoi An – A Step Back in Time


Our final day was dedicated to the UNESCO-listed Hoi An Ancient Town. We started with a thrilling (and dizzying!) Basket Boat Ride at Cam Thanh Coconut Village, where the team tested their balance and cheered on the local boat performers. Later, we strolled through Hoi An’s lantern-lit streets, admired the Japanese Covered Bridge, and explored the local markets for unique souvenirs.



A Journey to Remember

As we returned home, we brought back more than just photos and souvenirs; we brought back closer bonds and a renewed energy to innovate. Vietnam was truly a wonder, and we can't wait for the next eScience adventure!

posts.title: eScience and Bureau of Customs (BOC) launch BayaniBox

blocks.content:
What is BayaniBox all about? 

If you've ever sent a balikbayan box from abroad to the Philippines, you might be familiar with the challenges that can arise during the customs clearance process. With the BayaniBox initiative, BOC and E-Science Corporation have joined forces to streamline and enhance the processing of balikbayan boxes, providing overseas Filipinos and their families a seamless and stress-free experience. 

The recent launch of BayaniBox, alongside several other automation projects, marks a momentous occasion in the Bureau of Customs' (BOC) journey towards embracing digital transformation. With a strong commitment to leveraging technology, the BOC is making significant strides in optimizing customs processes and revolutionizing the experience for overseas Filipinos. By introducing these innovations, the Bureau is not only easing the burden for Filipinos abroad but also bolstering the efficiency and reliability of international shipping. The launch event, held on July 21 at Sofitel Manila, signifies a brighter and more technologically advanced future for customs operations in the Philippines.

images.caption: This is a placeholder caption for this image

blocks.content:
Goals and Objectives of BayaniBox 

BayaniBox is set to commence its operations in the fourth quarter of 2023, starting with a gradual rollout to reach all countries from which balikbayan boxes are sent. This exciting venture promises to enhance the balikbayan box shipping experience, strengthening the bond between overseas Filipinos and their loved ones back home. 

The launch of BayaniBox signifies a significant step forward for the Bureau of Customs and E-Science Corporation in their commitment to leveraging technology for the benefit of the nation. By embracing digital transformation and optimizing customs processes, they are making it easier for Filipinos abroad to stay connected with their families and heritage. 

With BayaniBox paving the way, a brighter future awaits for overseas Filipinos and the entire nation through technology-driven progress.

You may be aware that the Data Privacy Act of 2012, gives certain rights to individuals in relation to their personal data. Accordingly, we have implemented additional transparency and access controls stated in this Privacy Policy to help users take advantage of those rights. As available and except as limited under applicable law, the rights afforded to individuals are:

  • • Right of Access : the right to be informed of and request access to the personal data we process about you;
  • • Right to Erasure : the right to request that we delete your personal data;
  • • Right to Restrict : the right to request that we temporarily or permanently stop processing all or some of your personal data;
  • • Right to Object :
    • - the right, at any time, to object to us processing your personal data on grounds relating to your particular situation;
    • - the right to object to your personal data being processed for direct marketing purposes;
  • • Right to not be subject to a decision : based solely on automated decision making, including profiling, where the decision would have a legal effect on you or produce a similarly significant effect.

sections.title: What do we use your personal data for?
sections.content:
We use your information to deliver our services. For example:

  • To record client contact information.

Measure performance

We use data for analytics and measurement to understand how our services are used.

Communicate with you

  • We also use your information to send you updates, notices, announcements, and additional information related to the Services;
  • We may also use your information to conduct surveys and questionnaires; And if you contact E-Science Corporation personnel, we may keep a record of your request in order to help solve any issues you might be facing.

The Services may include an internal messaging system which provides you the ability to send and receive messages to and from other users, and to receive marketing messages from us. You hereby agree that we may use the internal messaging system for the purpose of informing you regarding products or services, which may interest you.

sections.title: Sharing your personal data
sections.content:
E-Science Corporation does not sell, rent or lease your personal information to third parties without consent.

E-Science Corporation will not share your personal information with others, without your permission, except for the following purposes and to the extent necessary in E-Science’s good-faith discretion:

  • As necessary for the facilitation and operation of the Services;
  • If E-Science Corporation reasonably believes that you have breached the Terms of Use or is investigating potential breach of the Terms of Use, or believes that you abused your rights to use the Services, or performed any act or omission that E-Science Corporation reasonably believes to be violating any applicable law, rules, or regulations. E-Science Corporation may share your information in these cases, with law enforcement agencies and other competent authorities and with any third party as may be required to handle any result of your wrongdoing;
  • If E-Science Corporation is required, or reasonably believes that it is required by law to share or disclose your information;
  • In any case of dispute, or legal proceeding of any kind between you and E-Science Corporation, or between you and other users with respect to, or in relation with the Services;
  • In any case where E-Science Corporation reasonably believes that sharing information is necessary to protect against harm to the rights, property or safety of E-Science Corporation, our users, or the public as required or permitted by law, including to prevent imminent physical damage or damage to property;
  • To detect, prevent, or otherwise address fraud, security, or technical issues;
  • If E-Science Corporation organizes the operation of the Services within a different framework, or through another legal structure or entity, or if E-Science Corporation is acquired by, or merged into or with another entity, or if E-Science Corporation enters bankruptcy, provided however, that those entities agree to be bound by the provisions of this Privacy Policy, with respective changes taken into consideration;
  • To collect, store, hold and manage your personal information through cloud based or hosting services or a third party or a party affiliated or connected to E-Science Corporation, as reasonable for business purposes, which may be located potentially countries outside of your jurisdiction;
  • We may also have selected measurement services which help us understand how our users interaction with our ads and in order to measure E-Science Corporation own marketing efforts, by using and sharing the device’s identifier.
  • Personal information may also be shared with E-Science Corporation trusted partners and service providers to process it for us, based on our instructions and in compliance with this policy and any other appropriate confidentiality and security measures.
  • Anonymized data removes the data subject’s personally identifiable information.

sections.title: Data retention and deletion
sections.content: We keep your personal data only as long as necessary to provide you with the E-Science Corporation Service and for legitimate and essential business purposes, such as making data-driven business decisions about new features and offerings, complying with our legal obligations, and resolving disputes. We keep some of your personal data for as long as you are a user of the E-Science Corporation platform. Transactional records shall be maintained and safely stored for 365 Days from the date of transaction except where specific contract clause and/or regulations require a different retention period.

sections.title: Keeping your data safe
sections.content:
We are committed to protecting our users’ personal data. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to help protect the security of your personal data; however, please note that no system is ever completely secure. We have implemented various policies including anonymization, encryption, access, and retention policies to guard against unauthorized access and unnecessary retention of personal data in our systems.

Your password protects your user account, so we encourage you to use a unique and strong password, limit access to your computer and browser, and log out.

sections.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
sections.content:
This Privacy Notice is in effect as of April 30, 2019 and will continue to remain in effect unless otherwise directed by E-Science’s Data Protection Officer.

This notice may be modified by the Acabar, and modifications to our Privacy Policy may be released via official issuances, to which you will be duly notified of by virtue of the online registration details you have provided to us.

If significant changes to this Privacy Policy will affect your personal information, we shall notify you through the email address you have provided us.

sections.title: How to contact us?
sections.content: You have the right to ask for a copy of any personal information we hold about you, as well as to ask for it to be corrected if you think it is wrong. To do so, please contact privacy@electronicscience.com

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.content: eScience grew out of a passion for innovation and mobile technology. We are a team of software engineers, designers, and business development specialists with more than 2 decades of experience in building mobile applications. We are pioneers in providing high-impact products and services that capitalize on emerging mobile technologies such as Mobile Tablets (Android and iOS), 5G, and location based services.

familyCulture.title: Family Culture
familyCulture.content: eScience's greatest strength and unique advantage, setting us apart from any other companies, is our exceptional people and family-oriented culture. We consider our people as part of a big family and our company’s main asset. They are the heart of eScience’s success through the years, and behind the innovative solutions, extraordinary customer service, and technical support that we deliver.

vision.title: Vision
vision.content: eScience envisions to be the most admired IT Company in the wireless and secure e-transactions business, pioneering high-impact products that serve the global market.

mission.title: Mission
mission.content: We are called to excel and harness our God-given talents as Solutions Provider in order to serve humanity and make a difference in our community. We are: Architects of Innovation, Motivated to Make a Difference, Building State of the Art Solutions, Maintaining World-Class Standards, Making Excellence A Way of Life, A Team of Brilliant Minds.
